fact: At commit c86338d0ba6f891ae09bf39fc5f135eb1ad2b5c4, the Market Empire README records a completed one-round, seven-screen demo in which the player reviews market information, allocates cash across four investment sectors, sees a calculated market result and submits a sealed bid in a fictional property auction. Official financial and auction calculations live in a separate engine (src/engine) and the interface displays the engine's result. Investment-allocation and property-bid validation are implemented in src/engine/validation.ts. The completed version recorded 32/32 Vitest unit/calculation tests and 6/6 Playwright browser tests passing. Work was tracked through GitHub issues and merged pull requests, and the demo was reviewed by the project team and course professor and approved for presentation.
